title: Separating platform accountability from end-user business ownership prevents the acceleration of obsolete workflows
text: Applying AI to an unexamined legacy process accelerates waste—paving the cow paths. Sustainable governance requires separating technical platform accountability (infrastructure, compliance, model security) from end-user business ownership (workflow redesign, operational error liability, and commercial outcome).
qualification: Consulting governance framework synthesizing enterprise AI rollouts; reflects management advisory recommendations without third-party comparative audit.

public_locator.value: Paving the cow paths with AI accelerates chaos. Platform governance must be paired with explicit end-user outcome accountability.
